frequency_question: What proportion of policy review meetings result in a benchmark interest rate hike when baseline inflationary pressures are moderately elevated?
membership_rule: Includes all regular MPC rate-setting meetings for major emerging market inflation-targeting central banks (e.g., India, Brazil, Indonesia, Mexico) from 2011 to 2026 where headline inflation was above the midpoint target; excludes emergency inter-meeting moves driven solely by sudden capital flight panics.
coverage_note: 15 representative meetings sampled from recent tightening and pause phases; captures the conditional frequency of hikes given moderate inflation precursor states.
known_gaps: Does not exhaustively cover all emerging markets, but heavily weights RBI historical behavior since structural inflation targeting was formally adopted.
skeleton: RBI rate review cycles observed across tightening phases from 2011 to 2024, evaluated per 91-day window equivalent.
multiplier: 6 rate hikes out of 15 total observed regular/off-cycle decision windows during active tightening phases.
validity_reason: Central bank reaction functions and inflation-targeting mandates remain stable across multi-year horizons unless statutory frameworks are formally altered.
